findings.location: Body, under “There is a Twofold Worship Due Only to God,” item 1
findings.source_quote: “not out of a civil, but a religious respect”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “شہری احترام” with “معاشرتی احترام” or “عام احترام” to convey ordinary civil courtesy rather than civic/citizen respect.
findings.translation_quote: “شہری احترام کی بنا پر نہیں بلکہ مذہبی تعظیم کے طور پر”
